facts.text: Niagara's tourist attractions, festivals and special events attract more than 13 million tourists each year, over 3 million of them from the United States and about 1 million from overseas.
Niagara's tourism industry generates about $3.8 billion in annual visitor spending and employs more than 36,000 people.
Ontario's Destination Niagara Strategy aims to strengthen tourism in the area, with the potential to attract nearly 25 million visitors annually and double the economic impact of tourism.
Fallsview Casino Resort, built on a cliff overlooking the Horseshoe Falls, is the largest gaming resort facility in Canada with over 3,200 slot machines and 110 gaming tables.

overview: Niagara Falls had 94,415 residents in the 2021 Census, up 7.2% from 88,071 in 2016. The median age is 44.8 and the median household income in 2020 was $74,500, so the resident market is older and modest in size, spread across 37,793 dwellings on 210.25 square kilometres.

The real scale comes from visitors. Millions of tourists arrive in Niagara each year, spending billions and supporting tens of thousands of jobs. A local business serves two very different audiences: neighbours and travellers.
